timeline.summary: Krsnaa Diagnostics disclosed income tax demands aggregating ₹11.31 Cr for Assessment Years 2018-19 and 2019-20.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹192.6 Cr (+3.5% YoY), net profit ₹41.72 Cr (+101.7% YoY).
Krsnaa Diagnostics Limited shared the audio recording link for its earnings call on May 26, 2026, at 12:30 IST for Q4FY26 and FY26.
Director **Darshankumar Rajendrakumar Jain** (DIN:11564137) declared no encumbrances on promoter shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026.
Krsnaa Diagnostics expanded its Himachal Pradesh PPP contract to operate CT scan facilities at 34 government institutions.
Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹235.53 Cr (+22.0% YoY), net profit ₹16.55 Cr (-19.3% YoY).
Krsnaa Diagnostics board approved a preferential issue of share warrants to the Promoter and Promoter Group.
Krsnaa Diagnostics Limited shared the earnings call recording for Q1 FY27 (ended June 30, 2026) via its website on August 14, 2026, at 13:00 IST, signed by **Sujoy Sudipta Bose**.
Krsnaa Diagnostics held Q1FY27 earnings call on August 14, 2026, reporting revenue of ₹235.5 Cr (+22% YoY), EBITDA margin of 25%, and retail revenue of ₹19.3 Cr (+64% YoY).
Krsnaa Diagnostics received an additional tax demand of ₹12.1 Cr for AY2022-23, increasing the payable amount to ₹31.73 Cr
2026-09-16: Executed 15-year PET-CT concession agreement with Government of Punjab under PPP model
Krsnaa Diagnostics announced shareholder approval for the issuance of up to 16,21,000 convertible warrants to promoters via postal ballot.
2026-09-28: Board approved sale of diagnostic equipment for up to ₹120 Cr
Krsnaa Diagnostics Limited’s 16th AGM on September 28, 2026, approved audited standalone and consolidated financial statements for FY2026 with 100% promoter votes.
Krsnaa Diagnostics Limited corrected AGM voting results on September 30, 2026, fixing an error in promoter interest disclosure for resolutions.
2026-10-08: Received in-principle approval from BSE and NSE for ₹91.75 Cr preferential warrant issue to promoter group
Krsnaa Diagnostics allotted 16.21 lakh convertible warrants to promoters at ₹566 each, raising ₹22.94 Cr upfront.
2026-10-22: Partnered with AZmed to evaluate radiology AI software across 5 million annual X-rays
